name: Teethcore
summary: Teethcore (sometimes called Toothcore ) is a surreal internet aesthetic that uses the imagery of human teeth as its central visual motif.
description:
Teethcore (sometimes called Toothcore ) is a surreal internet aesthetic that uses the imagery of human teeth as its central visual motif. Emerging from Tumblr in the mid-to-late 2010s, it is a specific offshoot of the Morute ("morbid cute") and Gurokawa ("grotesque cute") scenes. The aesthetic is defined by its practice of decontextualizing teeth, presenting them not as parts of a body, but as strange, uncanny objects for art and decoration.

The core of the aesthetic lies in the juxtaposition of the clinical, grotesque, or visceral nature of teeth with sentimental or delicate contexts. It often explores themes of body horror, dental anxiety, and a fascination with the macabre, frequently functioning as a form of "vent art" for its creators to express these feelings.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Uncanniness, surrealism, fascination with the grotesque, bodily autonomy, coping with anxiety
